# Ingest fixtures

Every file in this folder is invented: the titles, authors, abstracts, identifiers and licenses are made up, and the identifiers sit outside the live PubMed, PMC and arXiv ranges. The file names copy the shape of the live API paths because `tests/recorded_http.py` keys on the URL path and the picked parameters. None of these files is a recording of a real response, so no license applies to their content.
